name: std::basic_filebuf<CharT,Traits>::is_open
intro: Returns true if the most recent call to open() succeeded and there has been no call to close() since then.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: true if the associated file is open, false otherwise.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: This function is typically called by std::basic_fstream::is_open().

examples.output:
direct call: true
through streambuf: true
through fstream: true

summary: Returns true if the most recent call to open() succeeded and there has been no call to close() since then.
